answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 19383 Country: India Title: My company provides filtered driking water to employees for free of cost. Is it permissible to bring water to home from office for personal use i.e. driking water for baby? Question: My company provides filtered driking water to employees for free of cost. Is it permissible to bring water to home from office for personal use i.e. driking water for baby? Answer ID: 19383 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 182/182/M=1431) If the company gives the water in the possession of the employees, or it allows the employees to carry it to home, then it is lawful. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
